name: Soup with Supplì
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Shape the leftover risotto into little balls the size of nuts.
Dip the balls into beaten egg, then roll them in bread crumbs.
Fry the breaded risotto balls in butter, then drain them from the grease.
Serve the risotto balls in hot broth.

culture.text: Soup with supplì is not traditional in Italy, where the preparation stops at the cooking of the supplì (risotto balls), which are a little bigger than eggs.
